# HEM v0.7.4b1 — Visible PID parameters and reliable calibration feedback

- Keeps Kp, Ki and Kd visible in each device's PID settings without enabling Advanced. Existing operating-mode sections and paired Approve/Discard actions remain together.
- Adds a compact PID status panel with effective gains, calibration method, accepted-cycle progress, readable waiting/rejection reasons, pending gain proposals, and the last applied old/new values. Heating, cooling and dehumidification evidence is shown only for its own mode. English, Greek and German explanations are included.
- Records normal target-satisfied OFF observations so passive learning can finish a cycle and collect the next baseline. Native state is still verified; a shutdown request alone never counts as physical OFF.
- Fixes the OFF-baseline buffer at the supported two-minute sampling interval and preserves verified ON/OFF transitions that occur between ordinary samples.
- Prevents a queued calibration from using an earlier mode, sensor, target or fan context after that context changes. Applications are serialized with the physical controller and checked again immediately before saving. Existing mode-scoped persistence, daily automatic cooldown and additional-cycle requirements remain covered by full-runtime tests.
- Enforces the advertised 10% relative adjustment limit for nonzero gains, including small values. A zero integral gain stays zero until explicitly edited; adaptive tuning retains the existing derivative gain.
- Reports unsupported adaptive configurations and blocked observations clearly. Recommendations expire when their observed context changes. New calibration records store the applied gains and mode; old records are not given invented historical values.

Passive calibration still requires suitable natural operating cycles. This beta improves observation, application guards and feedback; it does not force test cycles or relax the model-quality checks.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard to load the updated card.
